_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process under each strategy, simulated for 400,000 patients by fixture.truth() (Monte Carlo SD of the difference about 0.001)

agreement._note: In place of a second language, harness/selfcontrolled_examples.test.py re-implements clone-censor-weight in numpy and requires it to reproduce r.R's committed risks to 1e-8, and recomputes the truth with a different Monte Carlo seed (agreeing within 0.006).

recovery.claim: the estimate is close to the fixture's

calibration.rule: about 1.3 times the measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: Mean bias of the weighted estimate over 100 seeds +0.004 (Monte Carlo error in the truth is about 0.001). The tolerance separates the effect (-0.21) from zero; it is looser than the unweighted analysis's mean bias (0.044), which is caught by the control file's mean-bias assertion rather than by recovery. Measured by harness/selfcontrolled_examples.test.py on seeds 0 to 99.
